description: List the cases (conversations) raised by members of one organization, newest-updated first. Kayako: GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/cases.json.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

name: kayako_list_organization_cases
title: List an organization's cases
